verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is an API-driven service, so automation can run without a UI. Its docs describe server-to-server Cart API session flows, batch Feed API uploads of up to 200 items, webhooks in place of polling, and published OpenAPI definitions. Nothing in the evidence addresses CI specifically, such as a CLI, test or sandbox environments for pipelines, or non-interactive auth guidance. missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline usage, an official CLI or headless runner, test-environment automation guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
